Cheat.Player.LookAway: All other players should now look away. Open your eyes again when you hear the beep.
Cheat.Player.OpenEyes: All players can now open their eyes again.
Cheat.Menu.Instructions: Use the arrow keys to navigate & [SPACE] to select cards. Select 1-4 cards and press [ENTER] when finished.
Cheat.Player.RankClaimPrompt:
Now, enter the rank that you want to clam the cards are, 2-10, Jack, Queen, King or Ace.
Press [ENTER] to submit your claim & move on.
Cheat.Player.InvalidClaim: That input didn't look quite right. Please try again.
Cheat.Player.RankConfirmation: You claimed that the cards you played are of rank {rank}. Is this what you intended?
Cheat.Player.CheatPrompt:
Any player who believes that {player} cheated should now press any key, then select their name.
Otherwise, allow the timer to finish and continue.
Cheat.CheatCalled.LookAway:
{accuser} has accused {accused} of cheating!
All players except those two should please close their eyes and only re-open them when they hear the beep.
Cheat.Player.Cheated: {player} cheated! They pick up the pile.
Cheat.Player.Truthful: {player} did not cheat! You pick up the pile.
Cheat.Player.Won: {player} has won the game! They win cr{amount}!
